identity.title: Timeline of events in Pokémon the Series: XY

leadText: In , Ash Ketchum arrives in the Kalos region to pursue his dream of becoming a Pokémon Master. He meets , an inventor and the Lumiose City Gym Leader; his young sister ; and , a childhood acquaintance of his who joins them on their . Together, Ash and travel across Kalos as Ash aims to collect eight Gym Badges to qualify for the Kalos League, while Serena, after much consideration what her goal should be, chooses to become a Pokémon Performer and compete in Pokémon Showcases to become the . During this journey, the group uncovers the mysteries of Mega Evolution and ends up coming face to face with the villainous Team Flare.
